## ITERFORGE engineering standards
- Schema changes only via Flyway/Liquibase migrations in a reviewed PR. ddl-auto = validate or none.
- Never hard-code secrets; use ${ENV_VAR} placeholders. Real values live in AWS Secrets Manager.
- Never connect to prod databases or prod kube contexts from a laptop.
- Branch from develop, open a PR; never push to main/develop or force push.
- guardrails-core asks before risky actions (red or yellow dialog). Don't work around it; if the user cancels, don't retry another way; explain the safe alternative.

## Sensitive content
- You may read files, logs and output that contain secrets, customer PII or confidential info, and continue the task.
- Never repeat the values in replies, code, commits, logs or files; refer to them by kind and location ("customer email in app.log", "API_TOKEN in .env").
- If a real credential is somewhere it shouldn't be, name the file and the kind of secret, and recommend rotating it.
